recommended_initial_guard.evaluation: attention_required when either threshold is exceeded for an accessible nonempty root; never inactivate candidates for a guarded run
recommended_initial_guard.scope: evaluate accepted rows per root, not the pre-server files_found total

rationale: The largest observed ordinary one-day decrease was 42 files (0.0192%). A 1000-file or 1% threshold is more than 23 times the observed absolute decrease while remaining conservative against unsafe inactivation. The shared contract must keep the values configurable and must establish per-root accepted-count history before automatic reconciliation.
